meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码变更自动转为解说视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要向团队解释代码变更内容
copy.tagline_en: Turn code changes into explainer videos automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain code changes to your team

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据 GitHub 拉取请求（PR）的代码变更，自动生成一段解释视频，包含变更日志、功能展示、修复说明或重构讲解。
howto.when: 当你提供 PR 的 URL、仓库名#编号，或在已检出仓库中说“这个 PR”时触发。

say.text: 帮我为这个 PR 做一个代码变更讲解视频。
say.note: Claude 会开始分析 PR 并生成视频。

say.text: 把 acme-sdk#1842 的改动做成一个 changelog 视频。
say.note: Claude 会获取该 PR 并制作视频。

say.text: 为当前仓库的这个 PR 生成一个修复说明视频。
say.note: Claude 会使用当前检出的 PR。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can turn a GitHub pull request (PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or say 'this PR' in a checked-out repository.

say_en.text: Make a code-change explainer video for this PR.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the PR and start building the video.

say_en.text: Turn acme-sdk#1842 into a changelog video.
say_en.note: Claude fetches that PR and produces a changelog video.

say_en.text: Generate a fix explainer video for the current repo's PR.
say_en.note: Claude uses the currently checked-out PR.
